success_patterns: Agents generally matched each requested deliverable to a purpose-specific endpoint and kept distinct actions as separate calls.
When a request named multiple entities for a single-item endpoint, agents generally made a call for each entity and reused the requested operation.

patch.reasoning: These recurring patterns duplicate the broad endpoint-selection and request-coverage guidance proposed in earlier rejected edits, so I am not repeating them. The remaining parameter discrepancies are inconsistent across tools and do not support a new general rule.
